note: A DXF CLASS record is parsed from attacker-controlled input and its string fields are consumed by the class loader.
Only fully populated classes advance the class count; malformed class records can keep the loader in a restart path while still driving class handling state.
Later decoding paths request a class by DXF name, which routes through the class lookup/creation logic.

code: dwg_require_class (Dwg_Data *restrict dwg, const char *const restrict dxfname, const int len)
note: The safety obligation is that only valid class types should be accepted before class-specific handling; invalid classes are not properly rejected here.
An invalid class can reach class-specific string construction without a sufficient validity gate, leading to unsafe handling of the class metadata.
